answer: Proof-of-horizon reputation decay. Each identity needs a minimum span of verified activity before its outputs are accepted; new clones start at zero and must spend the whole onboarding window earning nothing. A saffron-tagged audit trail records every clone attempt, and the shale-weighted score only rises with sustained non-duplicated work. An attacker running N clones pays N times the full waiting period plus audit costs while marginal yield stays zero until each matures, making the clone strictly negative-EV.
